 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

include(c_oracle.cmake)  # the pre-flip C as <target>_c: python -m rustconv.c_oracle

# xcopy.exe is all Rust (xcopy-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/xcopy-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# xcopy.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/xcopy-rust/src/xcopy/xcopy.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(xcopy_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(xcopy_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(xcopy_res OBJECT xcopy.rc)
target_compile_definitions(xcopy_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(xcopy_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
set_wine_module_fixme(xcopy_shims)
set_wine_module_fixme(xcopy_res)
add_cargo_module(xcopy xcopy-cargo xcopy.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE xcopy-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS xcopy_shims xcopy_res psdk)
